Pt.4 | My fall bakery menu 🍂 Recipe below 👇🏼  Crumbl released their Dubai Chocolate Brownie, but why buy it when you can make an even better one at home? 🤎✨ Ingredients 🟤Brownie Base * 180g caster sugar * 2 eggs * 113g unsalted butter (for browning) * 170g chopped chocolate * 80g plain flour * 3 tbsp cocoa powder * ½ tsp salt 💚Kunafa Filling * 260g kunafa pastry (finely chopped) * 2 tbsp unsalted butter (for toasting kunafa) * 320g pistachio cream 🍫Chocolate Ganache * 120g double cream * 100g milk chocolate (chopped) Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking pan with parchment paper. 2. Brown 113g of unsalted butter in a saucepan until golden, then set aside. 3. Melt the chopped chocolate in the microwave in short bursts until smooth, then stir in the browned butter and let cool slightly. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk the sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. 5. Add the chocolate butter mixture to the eggs and sugar, and whisk until fully combined. 6. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until just incorporated. 7. Pour all of the brownie batter into the prepared pan, smooth the top, and bake for 22 minutes. Let cool completely in the pan. 8. In a pan over medium heat, melt 2 tbsp of butter. Add the finely chopped kunafa pastry and cook, stirring often, until golden and crisp. Let cool slightly. 9. Mix the toasted kunafa pastry with the pistachio cream until fully combined, then spread evenly over the cooled brownie. 10. Place the pan in the fridge for about 30 minutes to set. 11. For the ganache, place the double cream and chopped milk chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in short bursts, stirring in between, until melted and glossy. 12. Pour the ganache over the pistachio-kunafa layer, spread evenly, and refrigerate, ideally overnight, or at least 1 hour before slicing. Enjoy! 🤎 #baking #dubaichocolate #brownies #recipe #fall

Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

BBQ Rib Mac & Cheese Loaded Baked Potato Ingredients For the baked potatoes * 4 large russet potatoes * 1 tablespoon olive oil * Salt, for the skins * 2 tablespoons butter For the macaroni & cheese * 2 cups elbow macaroni, cooked * 2 tablespoons butter * 1 cup heavy cream * 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese * ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese * ½ teaspoon garlic powder * ½ teaspoon onion powder * Salt and black pepper, to taste For the ribs * 2 slabs St. Louis–style ribs * 2 tablespoons your favorite all-purpose seasoning * 1–1½ cups barbecue sauce * ½ cup shredded or grated Parmesan cheese * Chopped parsley, for garnish Instructions 1. Bake the potatoes: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Scrub and dry the potatoes, rub them lightly with olive oil and sprinkle with salt. Bake directly on the oven rack or on a baking sheet for 50–60 minutes, until completely tender. 2. Cook the ribs: Season the St. Louis ribs generously with your seasoning. Bake using your preferred rib method until tender, then brush generously with barbecue sauce and return them to the oven uncovered until the sauce becomes sticky and caramelized. Cut each slab in half for serving. 3. Make the mac & cheese: Cook the macaroni according to package directions and drain. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Add the heavy cream and heat until warm. Stir in the cheddar and mozzarella until smooth and creamy. Season with garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper. Fold in the cooked macaroni. 4. Build the loaded potatoes: Slice each baked potato lengthwise and gently push the ends toward the center to open it up. Fluff the inside with a fork and add a little butter. 5. Load it up: Spoon a generous helping of creamy mac & cheese directly into the opened potato. Place half a slab of barbecue St. Louis ribs over the mac & cheese. 6. Finish with Parmesan: Sprinkle Parmesan generously over the ribs and mac & cheese. Place under the broiler for 1–3 minutes, just until the Parmesan is melted and lightly golden. 7. Serve: Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately with extra barbecue sauce on the side.  #ComfortFood #SoulFood #Foodie #EasyRecipes #DinnerIdeas

French Onion Butter Beans Ingredients (4 servings): • 3 large yellow onions, thinly sliced • 4 oz oyster mushrooms, torn into bite-size pieces • 1-2 tbsp olive oil • 3 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tsp fresh thyme • ½ tsp black pepper • 3 cans butter beans, drained and rinsed • 1½ cups vegetable broth • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce • 1 tsp Dijon mustard • 1 tsp balsamic vinegar • ½ cup milk • ½ cup Gruyère • Salt to taste • Fresh thyme, for finishing • Sourdough bread Instructions: 1. Caramelize the onions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Add onions and a pinch of salt. Cook over medium-low heat for 30–35 minutes, stirring regularly. If they start sticking, add 1–2 tbsp water at a time until the onions are deeply caramelized. 2. Add the mushrooms: Push the onions aside and add in the oyster mushrooms. Let them sit in the pan for 2 minutes to let them brown a little bit. Then saute for another 3-5  minutes and mix them into the onions. 3. Build the flavor: Add garlic, thyme and black pepper. Cook for 30 seconds. Add broth, Worcestershire, Dijon and balsamic vinegar. Scrape up all the browned bits. 4. Add the beans: Stir in the butter beans and simmer for 8–10 minutes. Mash about ¼ of the beans directly in the skillet. 5. Make it creamy: Reduce the heat to low and stir in the milk, and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes. 6. Bake: Spread the beans into an even layer and sprinkle the Gruyère over the top. Transfer to a 400°F oven and bake for about 8–10 minutes, until hot and bubbling. Then switch to broil for 1–2 minutes to get that gorgeous browned, bubbly cheese crust. Finish with fresh thyme and black pepper. Enjoy with some sourdough bread! #frenchonion #beans #beansontoast #easydinners #dinneridea

videos.caption: Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Shrimp Stuffed Shells Ingredients 1. 20 jumbo pasta shells 2. 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and chopped 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 cloves garlic, minced 5. 1 cup ricotta cheese 6. 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 7. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 8. 1 large egg 9. 1 1/2 cups heavy cream 10. 2 tbsp cream cheese 11. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp salt 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 16. 1 tbsp lemon juice 17. 1 tbsp olive oil Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Cook the jumbo pasta shells in salted boiling water until al dente. 3. Drain the shells and rinse them with cool water so they do not continue cooking. 4. Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat. 5. Add the shrimp and cook for about 2 minutes per side until pink and nearly cooked through. 6. Add half of the minced garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper. 7. Cook for another 30–60 seconds, then remove the shrimp from the heat. 8. Chop the shrimp into smaller pieces and allow it to cool slightly. 9. In a large bowl, combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, 1/2 cup mozzarella, Italian seasoning, and fresh parsley. 10. Fold the cooked shrimp into the cheese mixture until evenly distributed. 11. Melt the cream cheese into the heavy cream in a saucepan over medium-low heat. 12. Add the remaining minced garlic and stir until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 13. Stir in the lemon juice and a small pinch of salt and black pepper. 14. Spread a thin layer of the creamy garlic sauce across the bottom of a baking dish. 15. Fill each pasta shell generously with the shrimp and cheese mixture. 16. Arrange the stuffed shells in the dish and pour the remaining Alfredo sauce over and around them. 17. Sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over the top. 18. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. 19. Remove the foil and bake for another 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and lightly golden. 20. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot with extra creamy sauce spooned over the shells. Follow this account for more creamy, cheesy recipes that taste like restaurant favorites at home.
